description: This PHP source file defines the LicenseDao class, which manages database operations related to License entities, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and counting licenses, as well as checking for existing license names and IDs.

classes.name: LicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for License entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and license management.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Persists a License entity to the database.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its name.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of Licenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object for License list with applied filters and pagination.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Licenses matching search filters.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a License with the given name exists.

methods.name: getExistingLicenseIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing License IDs from a list of IDs.
